title: 🏥 Multiple Healthcare Jobs in Midland County, TX - Up to $2.9K/Week - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Healthcare hiring is strong in Midland County right now, with both local and travel roles offering solid pay and flexible schedules. Here are several openings worth a look:
Dental Assistant Employer: Abbeville Dentistry
Location: Midland, TX
Type: Full-time
Pay: Up to $22/hr
Join a friendly dental team focused on patient care and professional growth. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and continuing education support.
Travel Allied X-Ray Tech Employer: Voyage Health
Location: Midland, TX
Type: Travel/Contract (13 weeks)
Pay: $2,166–$2,280/week
Work a 5x8 day shift while supporting a top facility. Great for techs with 2+ years of experience looking to earn strong weekly pay.
Travel RN – Operating Room Employer: Voyage Health
Location: Midland, TX
Type: Travel/Contract (16 weeks)
Pay: $2,437–$2,565/week
Take your OR skills on the road with this 4x10 day shift contract. Ideal for experienced RNs ready for a new challenge.
Travel RN – Cardiovascular OR Employer: Voyage Health
Location: Midland, TX
Type: Travel/Contract (13 weeks)
Pay: $2,572–$2,708/week
Support heart surgery teams in a fast-paced environment. A great fit for RNs with CVOR experience.
Travel RN – PACU Employer: Voyage Health
Location: Midland, TX
Type: Travel/Contract (13 weeks)
Pay: $2,234–$2,352/week
Help patients recover safely after surgery. This 5x8 day shift contract offers steady hours and rewarding work.
Travel Allied CT Tech Employer: Voyage Health
Location: Midland, TX
Type: Travel/Contract (13 weeks)
Pay: $2,798–$2,945/week
Operate advanced imaging equipment and earn top weekly pay. Perfect for CT techs ready to travel.
